text:
Both assistants assign all four questions correctly: Literature (Tolstoy), History (WWII US president), Science (water's Lewis structure), and Art (Mona Lisa). Both follow the line-by-line format with one category per line and no explanatory text.

The only difference is presentation. Assistant A numbers each line to match the questions, which makes the mapping explicit. Assistant B omits numbers, which is marginally more minimal and fits "refrain from any extraneous words" more literally, but the reader must rely on line order. Neither choice clearly better satisfies the instructions, so this is effectively a tie.

[[C]]
